dimensions.name: Authority
dimensions.definition: How complete and operative the primary legal authorization is.

dimensions.name: Posture-to-practice
dimensions.definition: How far the jurisdiction has moved from authorization to a usable regulated pathway.

dimensions.name: Quantification
dimensions.definition: How fully a decision-maker can verify fees, dates, forms, license classes, and other launch inputs.

anchors.3: Current official inputs sufficient for scoped comparison

rule: A numeric score is dated analytical judgment, not probability. Unknown, proposed, unpublished, superseded, or nonbinding inputs must be held or visibly flagged and cannot be represented as final facts.
boundary: This dated educational comparison is not legal, investment, licensing, clinical, or market advice. A state authorization is not proof that a program is operational, an applicant is eligible, a license will issue, funding exists, or federal law permits the conduct. Reverify every consequential value with the named authority and qualified counsel.
